description: This file manages interactions with a Python web worker, including registering terminal handlers, running code, interrupting execution, and handling worker messages within a web application.

methods.name: getPythonWorker
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton instance of the Python worker.

methods.name: registerTerminal
methods.description: Registers handlers for print, input, and reset events from the Python worker.

methods.name: interruptCodeExecution
methods.description: Attempts to cancel current code execution or resets the worker if needed.

methods.name: runPythonCode
methods.description: Sends code to the Python worker to execute.

methods.name: sendListenMessage
methods.description: Instructs the worker to listen for new run messages after stopping.
